content: 🚀 Selected as upcoming Software Development Engineer (SDE) at Eternal!
📄 Our research paper ThermEval was accepted at KDD 2026 (Datasets & Benchmarks Track, A* Conference)!
👨‍🏫 Appointed Teaching Assistant for CS203: Software Tools & Techniques for AI at IIT Gandhinagar.
🥈 Won the Silver Medal at Inter-IIT Tech Meet 14.0 (IIT Patna) for ISRO's GeoNLI challenge among 23 IITs!
💼 Accepted offer to join Barclays (Investment Banking Division) as an AI Engineer Intern.
🔬 Began Summer Research Internship (SRIP) with Prof. Nipun Batra on Vision-Language Model evaluation on thermal imagery.
🎖️ Awarded Academic Citation for Semester IV at IITGN, recognizing the top 5 students in the AI branch.
⚖️ Built CourtRAG multi-agent legal simulation system for Inter-IIT Tech Meet 13.0 @ IIT Bombay.
🎓 Commenced B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence at Indian Institute of Technology, Gandhinagar!
